w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj is the solder that joins heart to heart. His affection removes quarrels, fills cracks and awakens goodwill.

In the evening he held a meeting with the family of a devoted bhakta. After 3 to 4 long sittings, Swamishri completely resolved the complicated problems among the brothers in the family over land and property. Everyone was pleased.

Swamishri said, "If there is unity, wealth will grow. Through disunity even the water in the pot dries up. In such matters, people are found who stir things up. They come to you and they come to them. They stir you up. They say, 'Did you get anything? You wore yourself out and still got nothing.' They say such things. This is a matter like a court case. Father! You too give your blessings that the boys are happy. You should meet each other from time to time. When there are family occasions, go to each other's homes. If there is a feeling of oneness, people too will know that there is nothing in your minds." Serving the nectar of years of experience, Swamishri satisfied everyone.

Then he himself put magas prasad into the mouths of all the brothers and elders. He sweetened their minds and mouths. He had a group photo taken of everyone. At such affection from Swamishri, everyone was choked with emotion. Tears welled up in their eyes. They did dandvat.

Tying the final knot of unity, Swamishri said, "That's it! Everyone be happy. Everything before and after has gone into the sea. Just as all of you in the family have lived together since childhood, live in harmony. We should also keep reverence and respect for our father. No one in the family should keep any grudge. Everyone has worn themselves out for the family; remember that."

At 11.45 a.m., the Governor of Karnataka, H.E. T.N. Chaturvedi, came for Swamishri's darshan. He was welcomed by Swamishri and was enlightened about the BAPS socio-spiritual activities.

Today in the afternoon, before resting, Mahant Swami Maharaj went to the bathroom to wash his hands. Here a sadhu said to him, "I have a big responsibility on my head, but I do not have that much skill."
"One needs a good nature. That's all... everything is contained (in that)," Swamishri gave wonderful guidance.
From this opinion of his, the deeper point was understood that there is no skill greater than a good nature.

ds.t: Shiro and dry vegetables in Bhadam
w: Today Mahant Swami Maharaj arrived in Nagpur from Dhulia. Leaving the RSS Bhavan here, he was going towards the mandir. At that time, recalling old memories, Premprakashdas Swami said to Swamishri, "We had gone to the village of Bhadam on tour. There a procession was taken out in a bullock cart."
Hearing this, Swamishri too said, "We ate shiro (a sweet) and dry vegetables."
Everyone was amazed to hear this, because Swamishri remembered even what he had eaten on this ordinary tour 45 years ago!!
Carrying the conversation forward, Premprakashdas Swami said, "There (in Bhadam) we slept at the station."

"(On that tour) we used every kind of vehicle: camel cart, bullock cart, rickshaw and so on," Swamishri added. Such conversations, which occasionally arise in his presence, open chapters on his devotion through hardship.
Today a devotee named Kishan Patel had come for a meeting. As soon as he saw him, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "From Kerala, Cochin..." Then he said, "The houses are next to each other..."

The devotee was overjoyed, because he had left Cochin in 2013, yet Swamishri still remembered exactly the visit he had made to his home in those years. He said, "'Next to each other' means that my house and my uncle's house were next to each other. Swamishri remembers even that!"
How vast is Swamishri's grove of memory!! A stream of memories keeps flowing from it.
